item.title: The Pragmatic Programmer
item.description: A timeless classic that changed how I think about software craftsmanship. The advice on writing flexible, maintainable code is as relevant today as when it was first published. Every developer should read this at least once.

item.title: Refactoring: Improving the Design of Existing Code
item.description: Fowler’s systematic approach to improving code structure is brilliant. The catalog of refactorings is comprehensive and practical. This book taught me that refactoring isn’t about rewriting everything, it’s about incremental improvements.
